subject.title: feat(ui): complete Control UI MCP App bridge

question: Should an authorized, visible MCP App be allowed to request one plain-text user message through the normal Control UI chat-send path after exact host confirmation and the proposed safety gates?
rationale: The patch appears technically coherent, but approving app-originated input into the user conversation is an intentional trust-boundary expansion whose acceptable consent and authority model cannot be inferred from tests alone.

options.title: Approve guarded messaging
options.body: Accept the proposed consent-gated, plain-text-only boundary and merge after required exact-head checks complete.

options.title: Land context updates only
options.body: Remove app messaging for now while retaining the live theme, dimensions, and reconstructed-view read-only improvements.

options.title: Pause the bridge expansion
options.body: Keep the PR open until maintainers define a different permanent consent or authority contract for MCP Apps.

recommendation.title: Approve guarded messaging
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed consent-gated, plain-text-only boundary and merge after required exact-head checks complete.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the assigned repository member and current feature driver with direct knowledge of the authority and consent design.
